content.about: Benin is a narrow country in West Africa, stretching from the coast north to the Niger River. It was the home of the Kingdom of Dahomey. Ganvié, a village built on stilts in a lake, is home to thousands. Vodun is celebrated on a national holiday.

standout.text: Benin is the birthplace of the Vodun (voodoo) religion.

didYouKnow: Ganvié is one of the largest lake villages in Africa.
Benin celebrates a national Vodun day each January.
The Dahomey Amazons were a famous all-female army.
